latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release providing comprehensive Alibaba Cloud AI avatar and video generation features.

- Supports seven core capabilities: LivePortrait talking-head, EMO talking-head, AnimateAnyone full-body animation, T2I (text-to-image), I2V (image-to-video), Qwen TTS (text-to-speech), and LingMou template-based avatar videos.
- Details API usage, required environment variables, and setup instructions.
- Includes a quick selection guide for choosing the right pipeline based on input and desired output.
- Lists supported models/regions for each workflow and provides command-line usage examples.
- Outlines available motion templates and voice options for video/speech generation.
